# Instagram Comments Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/instagram-comment-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-comment-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.643**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Instagram comments from posts or reels. Just add one or more Instagram post URLs to get comment text, post and comment IDs, replies, timestamp, owner IDs, usernames, profile pics. Export scraped datasets, run the scraper via API, schedule and monitor runs or integrate with other tools.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Comment $0.0026 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-comment-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-instagram-comment-scraper@0.0.643#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      directUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `directUrls` | string[] | yes |  | 🔗 Instagram posts or reels URLs — Add one or multiple URLs to scrape comments from - posts or reels. You can add URLs one by one or upload a list using the Bulk edit option. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | 💯 Up to [number] of comments — Set the number of comments you expect to scrape from each post or reel.  If set to 5, you will get 5 comments per URL. If you add 2 URLs, you will extract 10 results altogether. ❗️ If you choose to scrape replies as well, the total number will be greater than you set  |
| `includeNestedComments` | boolean |  |  | $ Include replies — This feature is for paying users only. If checked, the scraper will extract replies for each comment. ⚠️ Note that each reply/comment will be displayed as a separate result, so you'll get more results in total than you set in `resultsLimit` section above. |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `postUrl` | string \| null | URL of the Instagram post containing the comment |
| `commentUrl` | string \| null | Direct URL to the specific comment |
| `id` | string \| null | Unique identifier of the comment |
| `text` | string \| null | Text content of the comment |
| `ownerUsername` | string \| null | Username of the comment author |
| `ownerProfilePicUrl` | string \| null | Profile picture URL of the comment author |
| `timestamp` | string \| null | ISO 8601 timestamp when the comment was posted |
| `likesCount` | number \| null | Number of likes on the comment |
| `owner` | object \| null | Detailed information about the comment author |
| `url` | string \| null | URL associated with the comment or post |
| `parentCommentUrl` | string \| null | URL of the parent comment |
| `requestErrorMessages` | array \| null | Array of error messages encountered during scraping |
| `error` | string \| null | Error message if comment scraping failed |
| `errorDescription` | string \| null | Detailed description of the error that occurred |
| `repliesCount` | number \| null | Number of replies to this comment |
| `replies` | array \| null | Replies to this comment |
